'''Greg Heisler The Light Side Deck of Doom v2 0''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Greg Heisler]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-11098">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11098 The Light Side Deck of Doom v2 0], DeckTech (Greg "rabidjedi" Heisler, 13 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11098/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11098/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018110157/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11098/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''The Light Side Deck of Doom v2 0'''
* '''Author:''' Greg "rabidjedi" Heisler
* '''Published:''' October 13, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' I have made a lot of changes, and now it is much faster.

=== Strategy ===

The idea of the deck is the same.  I DON'T need space, regardless of whatever one says.  I drain for an average of like 6 to 9 on turn 2 or 3.  I will repeat this...NO SPACE  I put in Uncontrollabe for Vader, because it's still useful.  The other main difference is the addition of Staging Areas, since I grab the docking bays on turn 1 & 2.  If you have nay questions, mail me before you review this badly.
